record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Cubone (1 star) and Marowak (2 stars), both with passive NONE, declare BONEMERANG. Alolan Marowak is a separate unit with its own skill declaration and is not covered.
record.summary: Line attack: on the cast and again 1000 ms later, every entity not on the caster's team along a straight line from the caster through the cast target to the board edge takes one special hit (15/30/60/120 raw by stars). The line is not stopped by the first enemy: all enemies on it are hit in each pass. The second pass re-reads the caster's and target's positions when it runs, so the line may differ if either has moved (or the target died, in which case its last coordinates are used). The second pass is queued on the caster, so it does not happen if the caster dies before the 1000 ms elapse. No status, movement or heal.

targeting.who: every entity whose team differs from the caster's on the line cells; the cast target defines only the direction
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: line from the caster's cell toward the target and beyond (rounded endpoint 12 cells away, supercover cells, on-board only; width one cell, diagonal when the angle gives an exact tie); the caster's own cell is part of the line but is skipped as an ally. The board is 8 columns x 6 rows.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) per hit (apBoost defaults to true), with the AP value read at each hit; crit multiplies by critPower (reduced by each target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT); the same crit flag is reused for the second pass. No atk term.
effects.resolution: requested amount per hit = the raw table value; applied change per hit = after AP / crit, then PokemonState.handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, minimum 1), applies shields and other steps; the returned takenDamage is discarded. Blocked (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce per hit; a dead or resurrecting target takes nothing. Nominal total per enemy that stays on the line for both passes: 2 x the per-hit value before defences (30 for Cubone, 60 for Marowak, at AP 0 and no crit) - illustrative arithmetic, not a measured value.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 60 and 120 entries are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP is 80 and range 1 for both.

positionalConditions.text: The line starts at the caster and runs through the target; the second pass uses the positions at execution time. If the caster dies before the 1000 ms elapse, its pending command is no longer ticked and the second pass does not run.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast schedules its own delayed second pass; casts overlapping in time each keep their own pending command.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 15 (Cubone) / 30 (Marowak) per hit, two hits per enemy on the line 1000 ms apart. Per hit: scaled by AP (and crit if the cast crit), then reduced by SPE_DEF with ceil and min 1 and absorbed by shields in handleDamage. takenDamage is not consumed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPE_DEF division with min 1 and the block / dead gates were cited
